items.parse_summary: The main question asks what action the two divisions were commanded to perform. The reduced relative clause “going off duty on the Sabbath” identifies the divisions, with “on the Sabbath” specifying when they go off duty. The passive construction makes those divisions the recipients of the command and the intended performers of the action supplied by an option.

features.quote: the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath
features.required_operations: Attach “going off duty” to “the two divisions” and “on the Sabbath” to that duty transition, distinguishing these divisions from those coming on duty.
features.reason: The modifier identifies the particular divisions whose assigned duty is the intended target; it does not add avoidable background.

features.quote: What were the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath commanded to do?
features.required_operations: Understand the divisions as receiving the command and as performing the commanded action, then select that action from the choices.
features.reason: The passive leaves the command giver unstated but keeps the requested duty central. There are no competing participant assignments to maintain.
